previous.changeLog:
- Installer: Improved CN360 client compatibility during temporary version mismatch periods, so a separate CN360 only modpack build is not needed
- Updated MoE Overlay; Gun Caliber Overlay; Garage Mastery by Gravity_Assist (moved the overlay to Gameface)
- Updated Ballistics Info; MoE Tracker; Autoreloader Loading Overlay (ui scaling + resolution‑aware overlay positioning)
- Updated Hitmarker Pro (the marker and sound now appear only when you damage an enemy: a hit, fire or kill, each in its own colour. Simpler, and the sound is now instant and reliable on fast-firing guns like autocannons)

current.changeLog:
- Installer: If the game folder cannot be detected, you can now choose to install there anyway, with a warning that mods may not work correctly
- Updated enhanced modsSettingsApi 1.5.0 (the color picker now has your own color palette - save favorite colors once and reuse them in every mod, with live color preview under the cursor; right-click any color swatch to reset it to default or copy its code; the Apply button counts your unsaved changes, the mod search shows how many mods matched, and the window remembers your scroll position; mod authors can also ship their own color presets)
- Updated HitmarkerPro 1.0.4, BalCalcMod 2.3.7, AutoAim Indication+ 2.0.7, Show Vehicle 2.0.5, Custom Sixth Sense 1.0.7 and Crew Skills Pro 1.0.3 (fixed settings loading when the Windows profile path contains special characters)
- Updated Battle Result Unanonymizer 1.4
- Updated Scheduled Personal Reserves 2.0
- Updated MoE Overlay 1.7
